title: Settings
description: Manage your identity, calling preferences, privacy, notifications, and display.

errors.webhook: Could not load or save the webhook. {{code}}
errors.admin: Could not load or save administrator settings. {{code}}

account.title: Account and identity
account.detail: Your SparkCall identity is separate from your login session.
account.temporaryNumber: Temporary accounts use an automatically generated number and cannot claim a custom number.
account.numberCooldown: Numbers are case-sensitive. You can change your number once every 30 days.
account.upgradeDetail: Create a permanent username and password while preserving this identity and its eligible data.
account.upgradeSaved: Your temporary identity is now a permanent account. Existing contacts and call records remain on this identity.

audio.title: Audio
audio.detail: Settings are persisted and used on future calls. Actual audio bitrate can vary with network conditions and codec behavior.
audio.speaker: Speaker
audio.devicesDetail: Device names appear after you grant microphone access. Speaker switching depends on browser support.
audio.modeDetail: Auto prefers direct P2P and uses TURN only when needed. P2P media is not counted as TURN usage. Changes apply to new calls only.
audio.bitrateDisabled: The administrator has disabled user-controlled bitrate settings.
audio.unusedForceTurnCompatibility: Legacy Force TURN preferences are migrated to TURN-only mode.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.detail: Call audio is not recorded. Blocking and incoming-call settings are enforced by the server.
privacy.allowIncomingDetail: Declined calls are rejected before WebRTC setup.
privacy.showOnlineStatusDetail: Controls whether presence may be shared by future public-facing features.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.detail: These controls apply only to this browser. Keep SparkCall open and connected to receive missed-call notifications; closed-tab push is not available.
notifications.doNotDisturb: Silence incoming calls on this browser
notifications.doNotDisturbDetail: Incoming call pop-ups are hidden, not declined. Calls remain in your missed-call history. Other devices and configured webhooks are unaffected.
notifications.missedCallsDetail: Show a generic browser notification for new missed incoming calls. Caller names and numbers are not shown.
notifications.missedBody: You have a missed incoming call.
notifications.permissionDenied: Browser notification permission was not granted. Allow notifications for this site in your browser settings, then try again.
notifications.unsupported: This browser does not support native notifications.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.detail: Choose light, dark, or follow your system preference.

usage.title: TURN usage
usage.detail: Monthly relay usage from Cloudflare Realtime analytics. Sampled analytics may not equal final billing data.
usage.unavailable: Usage reporting is not configured or the analytics service returned no data. Calls can still work when TURN credentials are configured.
usage.platformDetail: Aggregate values are sampled estimates, not authoritative billing totals.

notes.Cloudflare Realtime Analytics is sampled: Cloudflare Realtime Analytics is sampled and time-windowed; this dashboard is an estimate, not exact real-time billing data. TURN billing measures egress bytes.

admin.title: Administrator settings
admin.detail: Changes are stored in D1 and override the public defaults in configuration.yaml.
admin.authorization: Only signed-in user IDs listed in the Worker ADMIN_USER_IDS variable can access this page. There is no shared administrator password; Analytics credentials never enter the browser.
admin.brandingDetail: Applies to page titles, navigation branding, logo, and the shared footer.
admin.logoHint: Leave blank for the built-in mark, or use a same-origin path such as /assets/logo.svg. External URLs are rejected.
admin.showPublicAggregate: Show app-wide usage to all users
admin.showPublicAggregateDetail: Off by default. When enabled, only SparkCall D1 snapshot totals are shown after at least the configured minimum number of users; no identifiers or Cloudflare account-wide totals are sent.
admin.minimumAggregateUsers: Minimum users before showing a total (5–100)
admin.monthlyUserQuotaDetail: Blank inherits the Worker TURN_MONTHLY_QUOTA_BYTES value; 0 means no displayed quota. This is display-only and never blocks calls.
admin.allowUserBitrateSettings: Allow users to set outgoing bitrate
admin.monthlyTurnLimitGb: Default monthly TURN relay limit per user (decimal GB)
admin.monthlyTurnLimitDetail: Blank means no limit. This is a sampled TURN-egress estimate, not total call traffic or a real-time cap; new TURN credentials are blocked only when a sample reaches the limit. If the Analytics token is missing or no usable snapshot exists, the check fails open and new credentials are still issued, so usage can overshoot. Existing calls continue, and direct P2P traffic is excluded.
admin.temporaryDetail: Account-creation controls return explicit errors. TURN relay limits affect only new relay allocations and never end existing calls.
admin.perIpCreationLimit: Temporary accounts per network per window (0 = unlimited)
admin.tempMonthlyQuotaGb: Monthly temporary-user quota per account (decimal GB)
admin.tempQuotaDetail: Blank inherits the per-user quota; 0 disables the displayed quota. This does not block or interrupt calls.
admin.tempMonthlyLimitGb: Default monthly TURN relay limit per temporary account (decimal GB)
admin.tempLimitDetail: Blank inherits the global TURN limit; 0 disables enforcement. Limits use sampled TURN egress and can lag; without a usable Analytics snapshot, checks fail open and new credentials are allowed. They exclude P2P traffic and never interrupt active calls.
admin.aggregateBudgetDetail: Blank or 0 means no displayed total budget. Sampled usage can be incomplete; this never blocks new or active calls.
admin.confirmReset: Reset all administrator-managed site settings to configuration.yaml defaults?
admin.resetDone: Administrator settings reset to public defaults.
admin.platformTitle: Cloudflare account-level TURN total · admins only
admin.platformDetail: Account-level Analytics data is server-side only and unavailable until TURN_ANALYTICS_API_TOKEN is configured as a Worker Secret with Account Analytics Read permission.
admin.dataUnavailable: No sampled usage data is available yet.
admin.capacityWarning: The limit is checked against a sampled value when TURN credentials are requested. At the threshold only new TURN credentials are refused; existing calls continue and P2P is excluded. With no Analytics token or usable snapshot, checks fail open and new credentials are still issued. Sampling can lag and overshoot, so this is not a real-time hard cap.
admin.userManagementDetail: Set an optional TURN relay GB limit for one account, all active accounts, or all active temporary accounts. Batch changes show and confirm the exact current target count; audit entries record the operator, scope, affected count, and time.
admin.individualLimitGb: Monthly TURN relay limit (decimal GB); blank inherits group defaults, 0 removes the limit
admin.batchLimitGb: Monthly TURN relay limit (decimal GB); blank clears overrides and inherits defaults, 0 means unlimited
admin.confirmBatchLimit: Apply {{quota}} monthly TURN relay limit to {{count}} accounts in {{scope}}? This will update the confirmed group now.
admin.invalidLimit: Enter a non-negative decimal GB value, or leave it blank.
admin.resetPassword: Set password and sign out target
admin.confirmPasswordReset: Set a new password for {{user}} and revoke all of that account’s sessions? The old password cannot be viewed or recovered.
admin.passwordResetDone: Password changed and the account’s existing sessions were signed out.
admin.exportDetail: Downloads pseudonymous active-user settings only. Excludes names, usernames, contact numbers, password hashes, sessions, device IDs, API tokens, and secrets.

webhook.title: Incoming-call webhook
webhook.detail: Optionally notify your HTTPS endpoint when a call arrives.
webhook.privacy: Only the minimum event data needed for an incoming-call notification is sent. The saved URL is never shown here.
webhook.events: HTTPS GET includes only the event type, call reference, and timestamp—not the caller number, audio, or credentials. The receiver or an intermediary proxy may log query parameters.
webhook.cost: DNS is checked when you save and when delivery runs, but Workers cannot pin arbitrary external DNS to the connection. Configure only a trusted public HTTPS endpoint; delivery may incur provider or network charges.
webhook.replaceDetail: Entering a new URL replaces the current endpoint; the field is always blank.
webhook.confirmRemove: Remove this webhook? Future incoming-call notifications will stop.
